d: Bindeshwari Dubey was a famous trade union leader and become president of INTUC - Congress Party's Trade Union organisation in 80s. He served as the Chief Minister of Bihar and later become union labour and Law Minister during Rajiv Gandhi's regime. He first sought attention during the emergency when he successfully achieved Sanjay Gandhi's pet project of family planning (popularly known as NASBANDI).
